newsitem.title: USA: John Nuveen to acquire Rittenhouse.
newsitem.headline: John Nuveen to acquire Rittenhouse.

text.p: John Nuveen Co, a municipal and corporate investment banking firm, said Tuesday it agreed to acquire Rittenhouse Financial Services Inc, which manages about $9 billion in assets.

Nuveen agreed to acquire Radnor, Pa.-based Rittenhouse Financial for $145 million in cash. The proposed transaction is expected to close by the end of September following regulatory approval, Nuveen said in a news release.

Rittenhouse Financial manages assets in individual equity and balanced accounts offered through broker-dealers. "The management of individual portfolios for affluent investors is an important and growing segment of the investment management business," said Nuveen Chairman Timothy Schwertfeger.

The acquisition is part of Nuveen's strategy to expand its business. "We're continuing to expand beyond our historical base to provide a broader range of investment alternatives to investors who rely on their investments as a primary source of their financial security," he added in a news release.
With the addition of Rittenhouse Financial, Nuveen manages or oversees more than $60 billion in products and services.
Shares of John Nuveen closed yesterday at 32-10/16.
